_comment: Fast-lookup index of every key file in the Archx repository: inputs, outputs, and single responsibility.

Cargo.toml.purpose: Rust crate manifest for the zero-dependency archx compiler (v0.8.0).

src/main.rs.purpose: CLI driver: flag parsing, extension/clobber checks, temp .ll handling, cross-platform clang invocation (-lm / MSVC), and --run execution.

src/diag.rs.purpose: 1-based source Span and Diagnostic error type.
inputs: line: usize, col: usize, message: String

src/token.rs.purpose: Lexical token enum (including Pipe, FStrPart, Float, SlashSlash, StarStar, Is, Assert, Pass, With, NoneLit) and token descriptions.

src/lexer.rs.purpose: 4-space indentation-aware UTF-8 lexer with f-string interpolation, float/underscore numbers, Pipe `|`, and Python keywords.

src/ast.rs.purpose: AST definitions for Program, StructDef, EnumDef, Func, Stmt, Pattern, Expr, CallArg, AssignTarget, and Type.

src/parser.rs.purpose: Bounded-depth parser supporting 1:1 Python syntax (def, class + __init__, enum, match/case, tuples, T | None, dict/set/slice, script main) and classic syntax.

src/codegen/mod.rs.purpose: LLVM IR module orchestrator, enum/struct/method/__init__ layout resolution, Codegen state, function frames, and runtime flag finalization.

src/codegen/analysis.rs.purpose: Pure AST static analyses: Two-Tier Adaptive Type Engine, SoA escape detection, monotonic while stride verification, mutation sets, and constant folding.

src/codegen/tuples_enums.rs.purpose: Zero-heap tuples, stack-inline T | None optionals + flow-sensitive narrowing, algebraic enum sum types, tuple unpacking, and composite RAII/region promotion.

src/codegen/pattern_match.rs.purpose: Pythonic match / case structural pattern matching (OR-patterns, guards, destructuring, T | None unwrapping, and compile-time enum exhaustiveness).

src/codegen/any.rs.purpose: Unboxed 24-byte %ArchxAny boxing/unboxing, runtime type guards, dynamic operations, indexing, and dynamic calls.

src/codegen/collections.rs.purpose: Planar <16 x i8> SIMD SwissTable dict[K, V] & set[T] lowering, per-type clone/drop helpers, Pythonic slicing, and negative indexing.

src/codegen/stmt.rs.purpose: Statement, Pythonic implicit variable binding, with region:, int/bool/float SoA setup, assert/pass, and assignment lowering.

src/codegen/loops.rs.purpose: while, range/a..b, for x in arr, for a, b in pairs, for k, v in d.items(), for ch in s, and enumerate lowering.

src/codegen/expr.rs.purpose: Expression lowering: scalars, tuples, dicts, sets, indexing/slicing, fields/Enum.Variant, // and ** math, ternary with T | None narrowing, and SSO strings.

src/codegen/calls.rs.purpose: User fastcc calls, __init__ & positional/keyword constructors, int/float/str/bool conversions, and LEGB soft built-ins.

src/codegen/io.rs.purpose: Pythonic console I/O & formatting lowering: print(*args, sep=..., end=...), input([prompt]), str(x), and f-strings.

src/codegen/methods.rs.purpose: class/struct self method definitions & dispatch, dict/set/list/any methods, and SSO-aware string methods.

src/codegen/ownership.rs.purpose: Deterministic RAII ownership: statement temporaries, recursive drops, deep clones, and region return heap promotion.

src/codegen/memory.rs.purpose: Checked malloc/calloc/realloc (align 16, 2^47 cap), element store/load/fill loops, and bounds-check elision proofs.

src/codegen/runtime.rs.purpose: Core on-demand LLVM IR runtime helpers (@archx_region_*, @archx_str_*, panic handlers) and core declarations.
outputs: Private LLVM IR helper functions and declares

src/codegen/runtime_py.rs.purpose: On-demand Pythonic LLVM IR runtime helpers (@archx_input, float formatting, string conversions/methods, and assertion/step panics).
outputs: Private LLVM IR helper functions and declares

src/codegen/runtime_hash_any.rs.purpose: On-demand Planar <16 x i8> SIMD SwissTable runtime, slice bounds/str slice helpers, and %ArchxAny dynamic runtime helpers.

src/codegen/tests.rs.purpose: Unit tests for LLVM IR codegen, tuples/optionals/enums/match, adaptive typing, Pythonic float SoA, SSO strings, and region escape checking.

examples/enums_matching.archx.lang.purpose: Runnable v0.8.0 showcase of tuples, T | None optionals, algebraic enums with region-allocated strings, and exhaustive match/case.

examples/comparison/full_tour.py.purpose: Python 3.10+ reference edition of the 5-way v0.1.0-v0.8.0 full-feature tour (byte-identical to full_tour_pythonic.archx.lang).

examples/comparison/full_tour_pythonic.a.purpose: 1:1 Pythonic Archx edition (byte-for-byte identical to full_tour.py), compiling ahead-of-time to run 22.9x faster than Python 3.

examples/comparison/full_tour_speed.arch.purpose: Speed/Systems Archx edition using [Body(...); n] SIMD SoA, with region: Planar SIMD dict/set, and stack enum Event (24.8x faster than Python 3).

examples/comparison/full_tour.c.purpose: Clang C (-O2 -lm) edition of the 5-way full-feature comparison showcase.

examples/comparison/full_tour.rs.purpose: Rust (rustc -O) edition of the 5-way full-feature comparison showcase.

tests/cli.rs.purpose: Cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows) end-to-end CLI and execution integration tests including v0.8.0 tuples/enums/match and full_tour parity.

benchmarks/run.sh.purpose: Builds, verifies byte-identical stdout via cmp, and times Python 3 vs C vs Rust vs Archx across all 6 benchmark suites.

.github/workflows/ci.yml.purpose: 3-OS GitHub Actions CI workflow (Linux, macOS, Windows), 11-target ASan+LSan verification, 6-suite Python 3/C/Rust/Archx benchmarks, and repo-committed logs/test-history.
